name: How May I Direct Your Curse
source:
What happens when you put a curse on hold?  A love story between murderous ghost and an overworked receptionist!  

Annet Turnbuckle is stuck in a dead end job at Toll Bridge financial, a sleazy accounting firm that seems to delight in making life miserable for its employees. But dead ends become dead coworkers after Annet starts taking calls from a mysterious and flirtatious woman who may seem familiar to fans of the horror genre. 


Throw in a nonbinary FBI agent,  a [REDACTED], and "that guy" in every office, and it's "Seven Days" to die or fall in love in this romantic supernatural-thriller!

[From [url=https://screen-savor-studios.itch.io/how-may-i-direct-your-curse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
要是接到詛咒來電，卻請對方稍候，會發生什麼？這是一個殺人女鬼與過勞的櫃檯人員之間的愛情故事！

安妮特．特恩巴克困在收費橋金融公司的一份工作裡，前途無望。這家無良會計事務所彷彿就以折磨員工為樂。可自從安妮特接到一位神秘女子曖昧的來電，沒前途的工作就成了會丟命的工作，同事們接連死去。恐怖片愛好者也許會覺得，電話那頭的女人有點耳熟。

再加上一名非二元性別的聯邦調查局探員、一個［內容已刪節］，還有每間辦公室都少不了的「那種人」，這出超自然驚悚愛情劇就到齊了。你有「七天」時間，要麼喪命，要麼墜入愛河！

［摘自[url=https://screen-savor-studios.itch.io/how-may-i-direct-your-curse]itch.io[/url]］
